modules.name: Initialize Particle
modules.description: Initialize visible particle state and capture initial Color/Scale. Emitter lifetime is preserved unless overridden.
modules.inputs_help: Position Offset: m; Velocity: m/s; Color: linear RGBA; Scale: multiplier; Override Lifetime: bool; Lifetime Min/Max: seconds; Seed: uint.
modules.order: First in Spawn, before Location and Velocity modules.
modules.tags: Initialization spawn particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Box Location
modules.description: Uniform volume sampling in a box, added to the current Position.
modules.inputs_help: Center and full Size: m; Seed: uint. Absolute Size is used.
modules.tags: Location spawn particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Sphere Location
modules.description: Uniform sphere volume or surface sampling, added to current Position.
modules.inputs_help: Center/Radius: m; Surface Only: bool; Seed: uint. Negative radius becomes zero.
modules.tags: Location spawn particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Add Velocity
modules.description: Add a constant velocity in simulation coordinates.
modules.order: After Initialize Particle; use Solve Motion in Update to move.
modules.tags: Velocity spawn particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Add Velocity in Cone
modules.description: Add velocity uniformly distributed over a cone solid angle.
modules.inputs_help: Axis: direction (+Y fallback); Half Angle: degrees [0,180]; Speed Min/Max: m/s, sorted and nonnegative; Seed: uint.
modules.order: After Initialize Particle; use Solve Motion in Update to move.
modules.tags: Velocity spawn particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Gravity
modules.description: Accumulate acceleration without multiplying by delta. No mass is used.
modules.tags: Forces update particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Drag
modules.inputs_help: Drag: seconds⁻¹. Negative values contribute zero.
modules.tags: Forces update particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Curl Noise
modules.description: A shared seeded 3D curl field, not per-particle jitter or the mmtest XY curl. Editable 12-sample central differences of a vector potential.
modules.inputs_help: Strength: acceleration multiplier; Frequency: noise units/m; Pan: noise units/s; Seed: uint. FBM octave/persistence controls are inside the graph.
modules.order: Before exactly one Solve Motion. More expensive than Gravity; no texture/bake input.
modules.tags: Forces update particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Solve Motion
modules.description: Semi-implicit velocity/position integration with exponential drag; clears both accumulators after use.
modules.inputs_help: Uses Context.delta in seconds. No module inputs.
modules.order: Exactly once, after all Gravity/Curl/Drag modules. Color/Scale over Life may follow.
modules.tags: Solvers update particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Color over Life
modules.description: Evaluate from captured initial state each frame, not from the previous frame result.
modules.order: Requires a Spawn writer for InitialColor.
modules.tags: Appearance update particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Scale over Life
modules.description: Evaluate from captured initial state each frame, not from the previous frame result.
modules.inputs_help: Multiplier: XYZ scale. Edit the Gradient/Curve inside this module.
modules.order: Requires a Spawn writer for InitialScale.
modules.tags: Appearance update particle Niagara 기본 입자

modules.name: Kill Particles
modules.description: Kill without resurrecting dead particles. Replace the Kill connection with a per-particle bool graph for conditional killing.
modules.inputs_help: Kill: bool, default false. A true instance input kills all particles reaching this module.
modules.order: Usually last in Update. Does not add a volume or event system.
modules.tags: Lifetime update particle Niagara 기본 입자
